sloka: द्रष्टुकामो ऽथ निर्यान्तं रामं जानपदो जनः ।यः प्राप्तः सो ऽपि दृष्ट्वैव स्वर्गायानुगतो मुदा ।। ७.१०९.१८ ॥
transliteration: draṣṭukāmo 'tha niryāntaṁ rāmaṁ jānapado janaḥ ।yaḥ prāptaḥ so 'pi dṛṣṭvaiva svargāyānugato mudā ।। 7.109.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, any rural person who arrived, desirous of seeing Rama departing, immediately followed him to heaven with joy upon seeing him.
